title: A Sound in the Dark
lines: Meg sat up in bed one night.
A sound came from near the shed.
Meg felt fear, but she went out.
They got close. Then the sound was clear.
A small pup was stuck in a box.
Meg has had that pup for a year.

questions.ask: What was making the sound by the shed?
questions.listenFor: A small pup stuck in a box. It comes near the end, so let them look back.
Dad. He is the one who says stay near me, dear.

questions.ask: What would you have done if you heard that sound? Why?
questions.listenFor: Any answer works. Listen for a because, not for bravery.
